001package org.clafer.ir.analysis.deduction;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.Arrays;
005import java.util.Collections;
006import java.util.HashMap;
007import java.util.List;
008import java.util.Map;
009import java.util.Map.Entry;
010import java.util.function.BiConsumer;
011import java.util.stream.Collectors;
012import org.clafer.ir.IrBoolVar;
013import org.clafer.ir.IrIntVar;
014import org.clafer.ir.IrRewriter;
015import org.clafer.ir.IrSetVar;
016import org.clafer.ir.IrStringVar;
017import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.string;
018
019/**
020 *
021 * @author jimmy
022 */
023public class Coalesce extends IrRewriter<Void> {
024
025    private final Map<IrIntVar, IrIntVar> coalescedInts;
026    private final Map<IrSetVar, IrSetVar> coalescedSets;
027    private final Map<List<IrIntVar>, IrStringVar> stringVarCache = new HashMap<>();
028
029    public Coalesce() {
030        this.coalescedInts = Collections.emptyMap();
031        this.coalescedSets = Collections.emptyMap();
032    }
033
034    public Coalesce(
035            Map<IrIntVar, IrIntVar> coalescedInts,
036            Map<IrSetVar, IrSetVar> coalescedSets) {
037        this.coalescedInts = coalescedInts;
038        this.coalescedSets = coalescedSets;
039    }
040
041    public IrBoolVar get(IrBoolVar var) {
042        return (IrBoolVar) coalescedInts.getOrDefault(var, var);
043    }
044
045    public IrIntVar get(IrIntVar var) {
046        return coalescedInts.getOrDefault(var, var);
047    }
048
049    public IrSetVar get(IrSetVar var) {
050        return coalescedSets.getOrDefault(var, var);
051    }
052
053    public void forEachIntVar(BiConsumer<? super IrIntVar, ? super IrIntVar> action) {
054        coalescedInts.forEach(action);
055    }
056
057    public void forEachSetVar(BiConsumer<? super IrSetVar, ? super IrSetVar> action) {
058        coalescedSets.forEach(action);
059    }
060
061    public boolean isEmpty() {
062        return coalescedInts.isEmpty() && coalescedSets.isEmpty();
063    }
064
065    public Coalesce compose(Coalesce other) {
066        return new Coalesce(
067                compose(coalescedInts, other.coalescedInts),
068                compose(coalescedSets, other.coalescedSets));
069    }
070
071    private static <T> Map<T, T> compose(Map<T, T> f1, Map<T, T> f2) {
072        if (f1.isEmpty()) {
073            return f2;
074        }
075        if (f2.isEmpty()) {
076            return f1;
077        }
078        Map<T, T> composed = new HashMap<>(f1.size() + f2.size());
079        composed.putAll(f2);
080        for (Map.Entry<T, T> e : f1.entrySet()) {
081            T key = e.getKey();
082            T value = f2.get(e.getValue());
083            if (value == null) {
084                value = e.getValue();
085            }
086            composed.put(key, value);
087        }
088        return composed;
089    }
090
091    @Override
092    public IrBoolVar visit(IrBoolVar ir, Void a) {
093        IrBoolVar var = (IrBoolVar) coalescedInts.get(ir);
094        return var == null ? ir : var;
095    }
096
097    @Override
098    public IrIntVar visit(IrIntVar ir, Void a) {
099        IrIntVar var = coalescedInts.get(ir);
100        return var == null ? ir : var;
101    }
102
103    @Override
104    public IrSetVar visit(IrSetVar ir, Void a) {
105        IrSetVar var = coalescedSets.get(ir);
106        return var == null ? ir : var;
107    }
108
109    @Override
110    public IrStringVar visit(IrStringVar ir, Void a) {
111        boolean changed = false;
112        IrIntVar[] chars = new IrIntVar[ir.getCharVars().length];
113        for (int i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
114            chars[i] = coalescedInts.get(ir.getCharVars()[i]);
115            if (chars[i] == null) {
116                chars[i] = ir.getCharVars()[i];
117            } else {
118                changed = true;
119            }
120        }
121        IrIntVar length = coalescedInts.get(ir.getLengthVar());
122        changed |= length != null;
123        if (changed) {
124            length = length == null ? ir.getLengthVar() : length;
125            List<IrIntVar> key = new ArrayList<>();
126            key.addAll(Arrays.asList(chars));
127            key.add(length);
128            IrStringVar string = stringVarCache.get(key);
129            if (string == null) {
130                string = string(ir.getName(), chars, length);
131                stringVarCache.put(key, string);
132            }
133            return string;
134        }
135        return ir;
136    }
137
138    @Override
139    public String toString() {
140        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
141        coalescedInts.entrySet().stream()
142                .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(Entry::getValue, Collectors.mapping(Entry::getKey, Collectors.toList())))
143                .forEach((newVar, oldVars) -> builder.append(newVar).append(" <--- ").append(oldVars).append('\n'));
144        coalescedSets.entrySet().stream()
145                .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(Entry::getValue, Collectors.mapping(Entry::getKey, Collectors.toList())))
146                .forEach((newVar, oldVars) -> builder.append(newVar).append(" <--- ").append(oldVars).append('\n'));
147        return builder.toString();
148    }
149}
